set.body: Add explicit comparison API for standard numeric index entities without rewriting source spellings or changing exact/regex query behavior. Run and echo (plus standard index custom keys flip/inv/split/chunk) compare ASCII integer strings ignoring leading zeros, without bounded-integer overflow. Labels such as subject/session/res remain exact. Invalid numeric formats are not normalized. Tests on JVM/JS include huge values, zero padding, labels, malformed values and rendering preservation. Needed by ScalaFIM native issue bd-01M1VJQBHABVPRGYYACQGSWHYX to pair real ds000001 run01 events with run1 derivatives.
set.title: Expose semantic equality for BIDS index entity values
